user.title: Add printer
user.description: Adds a button to every device created by the Spoolman integration, and creates a separate device holding the active spool's data. Add the integration again for each additional printer with a different Moonraker URL.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure printer
reconfigure.description: Renaming the printer also renames the buttons' technical entity_id (button.spoolman_spool_..._'name').

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Moonraker, or its [spoolman] component is not configured.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, please check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This printer (Moonraker URL) is already configured.
